meta.title: BALAND | Cultural & Educational Platform
meta.description: BALAND is a cultural and educational community grounded in learning sciences, cognitive neuroscience, and developmental psychology. BALAND — growing together toward flourishing.

home.heroTitle: Every child is a unique world waiting to be discovered
home.heroDesc: At BALAND, learning is grounded in a scientific understanding of the mind, abilities, and growth of every child.

school.title: A school for understanding, growth and flourishing
school.desc: At BALAND, education is more than knowledge transfer — it is a journey of discovering abilities, nurturing talents, and holistic growth.
school.preschoolDesc: The beginning of the learning journey — through experience, play, discovery, and the nurturing of foundational skills.
school.elementary1Desc: Building the foundations of learning, strengthening curiosity, and nurturing cognitive and social skills.
school.elementary2Desc: Expanding abilities, independent thinking, responsibility, and readiness for the next stages of growth.

children.title: Understanding the world of our children
children.subtitle: A space for understanding topics related to children's growth and learning.

parenting.title: Family companionship is part of the journey to flourishing
parenting.desc: Children grow within the family — through everyday relationships and shared experiences. Understanding their world leads to more meaningful companionship.

games.title: Play, discover, grow
games.subtitle: A space for cognitive play and simple educational activities.

memory.title: Visual Memory
memory.desc: Find the matching pairs. Strengthen your memory!

patterns.title: Pattern Discovery
patterns.desc: Find the next piece and complete the pattern.

focus.title: Focus & Observation
focus.desc: Find the target shape among the elements.

games.win: Well done! You completed the game.
games.disclaimer: These games are recreational activities and skill exercises — they are not psychological diagnostic tools or scientific talent assessments.
